title: Salvation
introduction: Salvation is the Bible's main theme - God's plan to save people from the consequences of sin and restore fellowship with Him. From the promise in the Garden of Eden to Jesus' finished work on the cross, the Bible tells the story of God's saving love.

sections.title: Humanity's Need for Salvation
sections.description: Sin has separated humanity from God, and everyone needs salvation.

sections.title: God's Love - The Foundation of Salvation
sections.description: Salvation flows from God's undeserved love for people.

sections.title: Salvation by Faith Alone
sections.description: Salvation is received through faith, not by one's own works.

sections.title: Jesus - The Only Way
sections.description: Salvation is found only in Jesus Christ.

sections.title: Assurance of Salvation
sections.description: Those who believe can have assurance of eternal life.
